usage: job_manager [-h] --store STORE --incarnation INCARNATION
                   --authority-uuid AUTHORITY_UUID
                   {submit,fresh-attempt,create,status,serve} ...

Submit Jobs to the v12 Job manager, read its status, or run its control loop.

positional arguments:
  {submit,fresh-attempt,create,status,serve}
    submit              record one versioned multi-Job submission
    fresh-attempt       admit a fresh attempt at a Job whose execution failed
    create              create one ordinary Job from a versioned template
    status              print the read-only status projection
    serve               run the persistent control loop

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --store STORE         the Job store's path; there is no default, and one
                        inside the checkout is what the external state root
                        exists to prevent
  --incarnation INCARNATION
                        this process's incarnation, which is what restart
                        recovery distinguishes managers by
  --authority-uuid AUTHORITY_UUID
                        the 32-lowercase-hex Authority this Job store belongs
                        to; it namespaces every episode identity the store
                        derives, is persisted on first open, and a later open
                        naming another one refuses without changing the store
